title: Business Event
description: A business event that the accounting engine under test must translate into journal entries. Phase 1 implements only 'manual_journal_entry' (explicit debits/credits). Phase 2 adds 'customer_contract_payment', the first higher-level event type: the reference model itself derives the deferred-revenue recognition entries from a declared recognition policy, rather than copying author-supplied numbers. See docs/scenario-authoring.md and docs/accounting-policy.md.

obligations.description: Used by type=customer_contract_payment: one entry per performance obligation funded by this payment.

service_start.description: Used by recognition_method=straight_line; must be the first day of its month

service_end.description: Used by recognition_method=straight_line; must be the last day of its month
